set -e; EXPECTED=908ec45c3ff1b4e78da28504a734e161025e22be; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; git fetch origin work/phase1-live-call-probes; git checkout work/phase1-live-call-probes; git reset --hard origin/work/phase1-live-call-probes; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; export ANDROID_HOME="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk"; export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="$ANDROID_HOME"; GRADLE="$HOME/.gradle/local-agent/gradle-9.6.0/bin/gradle"; "$GRADLE" :app:assembleDebug --no-daemon >/tmp/phase2d-resource-build.log 2>&1; adb -s "$SERIAL" install -r app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk >/tmp/phase2d-resource-install.log; grep -q Success /tmp/phase2d-resource-install.log; state(){ adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry 2>/dev/null | grep -m1 'mCallState=' | cut -d= -f2 | tr -d '[:space:]'; }; BT_BEFORE=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell settings get global bluetooth_on | tr -d '[:space:]'); cleanup(){ python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" hangup >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 0 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 8 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; if [ "$BT_BEFORE" = 1 ]; then adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd bluetooth_manager enable >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; else adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd bluetooth_manager disable >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi; }; trap cleanup EXIT; test "$(state)" = 0; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell ps -A -o USER,PID,NAME | grep -E '^shell[[:space:]]+[0-9]+[[:space:]]+shizuku_server$'; if [ "$BT_BEFORE" = 1 ]; then adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd bluetooth_manager disable >/dev/null; fi; for i in $(seq 1 40); do [ "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell settings get global bluetooth_on | tr -d '[:space:]')" = 0 ] && break; sleep 0.25; done; test "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell settings get global bluetooth_on | tr -d '[:space:]')" = 0; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 0 >/dev/null; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 8 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" dial 510100100 >/tmp/phase2d-resource-dial.log; for i in $(seq 1 40); do [ "$(state)" = 2 ] && break; sleep 1; done; test "$(state)" = 2; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 0 >/dev/null; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 8 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -c; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am start -W -n pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge/.DiagnosticProbeActivity --ez run_shizuku_endurance_probe true --el endurance_duration_ms 60000 >/tmp/phase2d-resource-start.log 2>&1; grep -q 'Status: ok' /tmp/phase2d-resource-start.log; sleep 1; TELE=/tmp/phase2d-resource-short-live.jsonl; python3 scripts/s22_resource_telemetry.py --serial "$SERIAL" watch "$TELE" --duration-seconds 50 --interval-seconds 1 >/tmp/phase2d-resource-watch.log; test -s "$TELE"; DONE=0; for i in $(seq 1 200); do if adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -d -v raw -s AiCallBridge:I '*:S' 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'shizuku_endurance_probe_result:'; then DONE=1; break; fi; sleep 0.1; done; test "$DONE" = 1; R=/tmp/phase2d-resource-result.txt; adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -d -v raw -s AiCallBridge:I '*:S' > "$R"; grep -q 'duration_ms=60000' "$R"; grep -q 'all_heartbeats_ok=true' "$R"; grep -q 'active_throughout=true' "$R"; grep -q 'duration_ok=true' "$R"; grep -q 'prepared_after_abort=false' "$R"; grep -q 'active_after_abort=false' "$R"; grep -q 'heartbeat_after_abort=false' "$R"; grep -q 'threads_stopped=true' "$R"; grep -q 'endurance_ok=true' "$R"; python3 - "$TELE" <<'PY'
import json,sys
from pathlib import Path
p=Path(sys.argv[1])
rows=[json.loads(x) for x in p.read_text().splitlines() if x.strip()]
app=[r['app'] for r in rows if r.get('app')]
helper=[r['helper'] for r in rows if r.get('helper')]
print('telemetry_rows=',len(rows))
print('app_samples=',len(app),'app_pids=',sorted({x['pid'] for x in app}))
print('helper_samples=',len(helper),'helper_pids=',sorted({x['pid'] for x in helper}))
assert len(rows)>=40, len(rows)
assert len(app)>=40, len(app)
assert len(helper)>=40, len(helper)
assert len({x['pid'] for x in app})==1
assert len({x['pid'] for x in helper})==1
def report(name, seq):
    first,last=seq[0],seq[-1]
    print(name+'_rss_kb_start_end_peak=',first['vmrss_kb'],last['vmrss_kb'],max(x['vmrss_kb'] for x in seq))
    print(name+'_fd_start_end_peak=',first['fd_count'],last['fd_count'],max(x['fd_count'] for x in seq))
    print(name+'_threads_start_end_peak=',first['thread_count'],last['thread_count'],max(x['thread_count'] for x in seq))
    assert last['fd_count'] <= first['fd_count'] + 4, (name,'fd',first,last)
    assert last['thread_count'] <= first['thread_count'] + 4, (name,'threads',first,last)
    assert last['vmrss_kb'] <= first['vmrss_kb'] + 16384, (name,'rss',first,last)
report('app',app)
report('helper',helper)
print('resource_trend_evidence_green=true')
PY
 echo call_state_before_hangup=$(state); test "$(state)" = 2; python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" hangup >/dev/null; for i in $(seq 1 40); do [ "$(state)" = 0 ] && break; sleep 0.25; done; test "$(state)" = 0; for i in $(seq 1 40); do [ -z "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pidof pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge:call_media 2>/dev/null | tr -d '[:space:]')" ] && break; sleep 0.25; done; test -z "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pidof pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge:call_media 2>/dev/null | tr -d '[:space:]')"; cleanup; trap - EXIT; for i in $(seq 1 40); do [ "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell settings get global bluetooth_on | tr -d '[:space:]')" = "$BT_BEFORE" ] && break; sleep 0.25; done; test "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell settings get global bluetooth_on | tr -d '[:space:]')" = "$BT_BEFORE"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; echo milestone_d_resource_trend_short_live_green=true
